items.source: Sets the default view class to requiredViewClass(): by default InternalResourceView, or JstlView if the JSTL API is present.
items.translation: 将默认的view class设置为requiredViewClass()：默认为InternalResourceView，或者如果存在 JSTL API 则为JstlView。

items.source: A convenience constructor that allows for specifying prefix and suffix as constructor arguments.
items.translation: 一个便利构造函数，允许将prefix和suffix指定为构造函数参数。

items.source: The view class for all views generated by this resolver can be specified via UrlBasedViewResolver.setViewClass(Class). See UrlBasedViewResolver's javadoc for details. The default is InternalResourceView, or JstlView if the JSTL API is present.
items.translation: 此解析器生成的所有视图的视图类可以通过UrlBasedViewResolver.setViewClass(Class)指定。有关详细信息，请参阅UrlBasedViewResolver的 JavaDoc。默认值为InternalResourceView，或者如果存在 JSTL API，则为JstlView。

items.source: Note: When chaining ViewResolvers, an InternalResourceViewResolver always needs to be last, as it will attempt to resolve any view name, no matter whether the underlying resource actually exists.
items.translation: 注意： 在链式配置 ViewResolvers 时，InternalResourceViewResolver 必须始终位于最后，因为它会尝试解析任何视图名称，无论底层资源是否实际存在。

items.source:
BTW, it's good practice to put JSP files that just serve as views under
WEB-INF, to hide them from direct access (for example, via a manually entered URL).
Only controllers will be able to access them then.
items.translation: 顺便提一下，将仅作为视图使用的 JSP 文件放在 `WEB-INF` 目录下是一种良好的做法，这样可以防止直接访问（例如通过手动输入的 URL）。此后，只有控制器才能访问它们。

items.source: Subclasses will typically call super.buildView(viewName) first, before setting further properties themselves. loadView will then apply Spring lifecycle methods at the end of this process.

items.source: Spring lifecycle methods as defined by the bean container do not have to be called here; those will be applied by the loadView method after this method returns.
items.translation: 由 Bean 容器定义的 Spring 生命周期方法不必在此处调用；这些方法将在本方法返回后，由 `loadView` 方法应用。
